title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.
  
  
What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.
  
  
Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Agents whose output nobody re-checks.**
You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.
  
  
**A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know.**
Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.
  
  
Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.
  
  
**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.
* An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.
* Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.
* 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.
* Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.
* Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.
* Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Compiler Performance Engineer**
to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

  

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
  
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
  
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
  
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
  
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
  
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
  
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
  

  
**Very Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
  
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
  
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
  
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

title: Senior Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Senior Compiler Performance Engineer**
to own major performance areas of Falcon. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. Your job is to push its generated code further, deciding which optimizations matter, designing them and delivering measurable speedups on real workloads.

  

You will work in a distributed team of compiler experts, with direct influence on what Falcon optimizes next.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Own performance of Falcon for a set of workloads or an optimization area end to end: analysis, design, implementation, validation
  
* Design and implement new optimizations and improve existing ones in the middle end and back end: inlining heuristics, loop optimizations, vectorization, escape analysis, speculation and deoptimization, GC barrier and runtime call optimization
  
* Drive code generation quality on x86\_64 and AArch64, including bringing Falcon to new hardware platforms
  
* Investigate complex performance issues reported by customers and turn findings into compiler improvements
  
* Review code, mentor engineers on the team and raise the bar for performance methodology
  
* Contribute to upstream LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 5+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills in large codebases
  
* Proven track record of delivering compiler optimizations with measurable performance impact
  
* Deep knowledge of compiler optimization theory and its practical tradeoffs: compile time, code size, correctness
  
* Strong performance analysis skills: profilers, hardware counters, reading and reasoning about generated assembly
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Significant experience with LLVM optimization passes or code generation; LLVM commit access is a plus
  
* Experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Deep knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
  
* Experience with JVM internals: garbage collection, deoptimization, profiling
  
* PhD in Computer Science or significant research experience in compilers

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.

Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.

■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.

■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs

■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.

description:

**Company:**
Finarb Analytics Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Kolkata

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site / Hybrid

About Finarb

Finarb is a data science, AI, and technology consulting firm that helps businesses solve complex problems through advanced analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation. We work with global clients across healthcare, financial services, private equity, and other industries, developing solutions that combine data engineering, predictive modeling, generative AI, and enterprise applications.

Our work spans traditional machine learning and deep learning to emerging areas such as large language models, agentic AI, and decision intelligence. We focus on building practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

About the Role

We are looking for an
**AI Engineer**
with strong Python skills and hands-on experience building applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and agentic AI frameworks.

The role involves designing and developing AI applications that can reason over enterprise data, interact with tools and APIs, execute multistep workflows, and integrate with existing business systems.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand the fundamentals of machine learning and data engineering, rather than just working with LLM APIs. You should be comfortable taking an AI application from initial development through testing, evaluation, and production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered applications using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Build agentic AI systems using
  **LangChain, LangGraph**
  , and similar frameworks, including tool calling, planning, state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Develop reusable agent tools and skills that can be chained together to execute complex analytical and business workflows.
* Build and optimize
  **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
  pipelines, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking.
* Integrate AI applications with databases, APIs, enterprise systems, and external tools, including MCP-based integrations.
* Develop backend services and APIs using
  **Python and FastAPI**
  .
* Design evaluation frameworks to measure LLM response quality, retrieval accuracy, agent reliability, and overall application performance.
* Implement appropriate guardrails, error handling, logging, and monitoring for production AI systems.
* Optimize applications for accuracy, latency, scalability, and inference costs.
* Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and software developers to build and deploy AI solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

* **2–5 years of experience**
  in software engineering, machine learning, or AI application development, including hands-on LLM application development.
* Strong programming skills in
  **Python**
  , including object-oriented programming, asynchronous processing, and API development.
* Practical experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph**
  , or comparable orchestration frameworks such as LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Experience building agentic workflows involving tool/function calling, state management, memory, and multistep execution.
* Experience developing RAG applications, working with embeddings, and integrating vector databases.
* Strong understanding of
  **SQL, data processing, data pipelines, and data quality**
  .
* Working knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including model training, evaluation, overfitting, and common failure modes.
* Understanding of transformer architectures, LLM capabilities, and limitations.
* Familiarity with statistical concepts such as distributions, sampling, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing.
* Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI or similar Python frameworks.
* Good understanding of software engineering practices, Git, testing, and debugging.

Good to Have

* Experience with vector databases such as
  **pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search**
  .
* Knowledge of advanced RAG techniques, including hybrid search, reranking, and agentic retrieval.
* Experience with
  **PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers**
  , and open-source LLMs.
* Familiarity with fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience with
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
  and developing integrations with external tools.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or Braintrust.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment.
* Understanding of AI security, prompt injection, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience optimizing LLM inference through model selection, caching, and routing.

What We're Looking For

We value engineers who can think beyond prompts and frameworks. You should understand how the underlying data, models, and application components work together and be able to make sensible technical decisions.

You should be comfortable experimenting with new approaches, evaluating results objectively, debugging complex workflows, and building systems that remain reliable outside controlled demonstrations.

Experience building and deploying
**real-world AI applications**
will be valued more than certifications or familiarity with a long list of frameworks.

Why Join Finarb?

* Work on challenging AI projects involving LLMs, agentic systems, machine learning, and enterprise data.
* Build production applications for global clients across multiple industries.
* Experiment with proprietary and open-source AI models and emerging frameworks.
* Work across the complete development lifecycle, from architecture and prototyping to production deployment.
* Collaborate with experienced data scientists, AI engineers, and software developers.
* Take ownership of technical solutions and contribute directly to product development.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Kolkata

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment:**
Full-Time

**Website:**
www.finarb.ai

title: IN_ Manager_ Agentic AI/ GenAI Architect _AppTech_Advisory_ Kolkata (Immediate joiners)
description:
**Job Description \& Summary:** 
 A career within Technology Consulting services will provide you with the opportunity to bring our clients a competitive advantage through defining their technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising architectural solutions that help them achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. We help build software and design data platforms, manage large volumes of client data, develop compliance procedures for data management, and continually research new technologies to drive innovation and sustainable change.
   

  

* We are looking for a highly experienced, hands\-on GenAI Architect/Lead to drive enterprise\-wide adoption of Generative AI and building Agentic AI solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise, solution architecture to enable GenAI\-led transformation across the SDLC and business workflows.
* You will work closely with engineering teams, architects, product owners, and leadership to design and implement scalable, production\-grade GenAI systems, while also acting as a thought leader and change agent for GenAI adoption.


**Job Position Title:** 
 IN\_ Manager\_ Agentic AI/ GenAI Architect \_AppTech\_Advisory\_ Kolkata (Immediate joiners)
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Technical Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead a team of GenAI developers and backend engineers to deliver enterprise GenAI applications and accelerators.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs, work breakdown, implementation plans, and engineering tasks.
* Review architecture, code, prompt design, RAG pipeline design, data model, API design, and integration approaches.
* Ensure quality, performance, security, maintainability, observability, cost efficiency, and production readiness.


 Advanced RAG, Semantic Search \& Knowledge Architecture
   

  

* Design and optimize RAG pipelines including ingestion, chunking, metadata extraction, embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, citation generation, and answer synthesis.
* Implement semantic search across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured knowledge sources.
* Integrate with enterprise knowledge repositories such as SharePoint, Confluence, S3, Google Drive, databases, ITSM tools, and document management systems.
* Define knowledge freshness, access\-controlled retrieval, lineage, deduplication, feedback loops, and retrieval quality improvement mechanisms.


**Agentic AI \& MCP\-based Tool Integration**
* Design and implement agentic workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or equivalent.
* Implement tool calling, memory, workflow state, human\-in\-the\-loop approval, API actions, and safe execution boundaries.
* Build or guide MCP server implementations for secure agent\-to\-tool and LLM\-to\-enterprise\-system integration.
* Evaluate A2A communication patterns for multi\-agent collaboration, delegation, and hand\-offs where relevant.


**Backend, API, Data \& Event\-Driven Engineering**
* Build scalable services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Java, or similar technologies.
* Design REST APIs and microservices for LLM orchestration, semantic search, ingestion, agent execution, feedback, and evaluation.
* Use SQL and NoSQL databases for application metadata, session history, audit logs, feedback, configurations, and workflow state.
* Design Redis caching patterns for session state, memory, rate limiting, token optimization, retrieval caching, distributed locks, and workflow continuity.
* Design asynchronous workflows using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Google Pub/Sub, or equivalent, including retry, DLQ, idempotency, ordering, and schema management.


**Evaluation, Observability, Security \& Governance**
* Implement LLM tracing, prompt/version tracking, token usage monitoring, latency tracking, cost monitoring, and feedback analytics.
* Define evaluation datasets and metrics for faithfulness, groundedness, answer relevance, context relevance, hallucination rate, toxicity, latency, and cost.
* Use LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS, DeepEval, TruLens, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent.
* Implement guardrails against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, toxic responses, and privacy violations.
* Support AI\-assisted SDLC adoption using GitHub Copilot, Codex, CursorAI, Claude Code, Cline, or similar tools.


**Mandatory skill sets:**
 Enterprise GenAI Architecture \- Reference architecture, platform strategy, reusable accelerators, NFRs, governance
   

  

 RAG \& Semantic Search \- Hybrid search, BM25, vector DBs, embeddings, re\-ranking, citations, grounding
   

  

 Agentic AI \- LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, planning, memory, human\-in\-loop
   

  

 MCP \& A2A \- MCP servers/gateways, tool ecosystem, secure execution, A2A multi\-agent patterns
   

  

 Backend API \- Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Java, REST, microservices, OpenAPI, API gateways
   

  

 Observability \- LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent.
   

  

 Data Architecture \- SQL, NoSQL, vector DB, object storage, analytics stores, metadata, lineage, audit
   

  

 Caching \- Redis, session continuity, memory, rate limiting, distributed locks, retrieval caching
   

  

 Messaging \- Kafka, event\-driven design, RabbitMQ, DLQ, retry, idempotency, event schemas, async workflows
   

  

 Cloud \& Model Strategy \- Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Hugging Face, SLMs
   

  

 LLMOps / MLOps / DevOps \- Prompt/model versioning, evaluation gates, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Chart, Terraform
   

  

 Security \& Responsible AI – Guardrails, prompt injection, LLM Shield, PII, privacy, compliance, audit, model risk management
   

  

**Preferred Skills:**
 Relevant Certifications preferred.
   

  

**Years of experience required:**
 9\+ years (with exposure GenAI/LLM ecosystems)
   

  

**Education qualification:**
 B.E. / B.Tech / MCA/ M.E/ M.TECH/ MBA/ PGDM. All qualifications should be in regular full\-time mode with no extension of course duration due to backlogs.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AIA – Mainframe Modernization Specialist**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Mainframe Modernization Specialist** 
 to join our
 **AI\-Driven Modernization** 
 practice, focused on transforming
 **legacy mainframe systems** 
 into agile, efficient, and cloud\-ready platforms. The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of
 **mainframe expertise, AI tools proficiency, and cloud technologies** 
 along with
 **hands\-on collaboration** 
 with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable modernization outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with technology leads, architects, and business stakeholders to analyse legacy applications, leverage AI/ML to automate code analysis and refactoring, and execute migration of mainframe workloads to modern distributed and cloud\-native platforms.

* Mainframe Systems Analysis and Understanding


*

+ Document current\-state architecture, data flows, batch schedules, and integration points across legacy ecosystem components.
+ Perform impact analysis and complexity assessment for potential transitions to modern platforms.
+ AI\-Driven Mainframe Modernization


* 
+ Apply AI tools and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
+ Develop and fine\-tune AI\-powered assistants to accelerate system conversion and code translation (e.g., COBOL to Java/Python).
+ Apply prompt engineering and context engineering techniques to maximise accuracy and efficiency of LLM\-driven modernization workflows.

+ Participate in the design and implementation of target\-state architectures aligned with cloud\-native and microservices patterns.
+ Ensure code quality, testability, and maintainability throughout the modernization lifecycle.

* 
+ Contribute to the design and development of API integrations and microservices to replace or wrap legacy mainframe functionality.
+ Implement RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integration patterns as part of the target\-state solution.
+ Cloud and Platform Integration


* 
+ Support migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven solutions.
+ Integrate modernized components with cloud\-native services, containerised workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.
+ Documentation and Reporting


* 
+ Create and maintain technical documentation including system designs, migration runbooks, and AI pipeline configurations.
+ Provide regular status updates on modernization progress, risks, and deliverables to project leads.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Professional Experience**
* 5 to 9 years of hands\-on experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM).
* Experience with data migration, integration, ETL processes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python and/or Java.
* Working knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with mainframe modernization tools or platforms (e.g., Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate) is a plus.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation and presentations.

* Work with global teams to drive real business impact through digital transformation.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.

**Technical AI Product Engineer**
 4–7 Years \| Full\-time
   

  

 If you want to move beyond experiments and build AI systems that truly power products and decisions—this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are building next\-generation AI\-powered products and platforms that transform how businesses operate, make decisions, and engage with customers.
   

  

 As a Technical AI Product Engineer, you will design and deliver production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions—owning the full lifecycle from problem framing to deployment and continuous optimization.
   

  

 This role is ideal for engineers who combine deep AI/ML expertise with strong engineering rigor and product thinking, and want to build scalable, measurable, and responsible AI systems in a real\-world enterprise setting.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Build AI Products, Not Just Models**
* Design and develop GenAI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows
* Translate business problems into measurable AI\-driven outcomes
* Define evaluation metrics and product success criteria


**Engineer Intelligent Systems at Scale**
* Build and optimize retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
* Develop agent\-based AI systems with tool usage and orchestration
* Deploy solutions on cloud\-native architectures (Azure preferred)


**Own the AI Lifecycle (GenAI Ops)**
* Implement prompt engineering strategies, embeddings, and fine\-tuning approaches
* Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails for reliability and safety
* Enable continuous monitoring of quality, latency, and cost


**Drive Responsible \& Secure AI**
* Embed responsible AI practices (bias detection, explainability, moderation)
* Ensure data privacy, governance, and compliance standards
* Build systems aligned with enterprise security and trust principles


**Collaborate \& influence**
* Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to prioritize AI features
* Influence enterprise AI architecture and best practices
* Enable teams through reusable AI components and APIs


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have Skills**
* Strong programming in Python and SQL
* Hands\-on experience with GenAI patterns: Prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings \& semantic search, Agentic workflows
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch / TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain / Semantic Kernel
* Experience deploying AI solutions on cloud platforms (Azure preferred): Azure OpenAI, Azure ML , Azure AI Search


**Engineering \& Platform Skills**
* Strong foundation in data processing (Pandas, NumPy, Spark/Databricks)
* Experience with MLOps / GenAI Ops: MLflow, pipelines, CI/CD, Docker, Azure DevOps
* Experience building APIs and integrating AI into applications
* Understanding of monitoring, observability, and system reliability


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience building agent\-based or autonomous AI systems
* Cost optimization for LLM workloads
* Multi\-modal AI (text, image, voice)
* Frontend integration for AI\-driven experiences


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ Data Engineering, or related field
* 2\+ years of experience in AI engineering or development


**Additional**
* Certifications in AI, genAI or Ganetic AI
* Experience with data governance, security, and compliance standards

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.

* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation.
